description: Output produced by C1 after detecting drift in a production batch. Sent to C2 and C4.

evidence_version.description: Version identifier for this C1 evidence payload. Used by C4 audit trail.

model_id.description: Identifier of the deployed champion model being monitored. Passed through from platform onboarding config.

reference_dataset_uri.description: Path to the reference dataset used during onboarding. Passed through so C2 and C3 can access it.

current_dataset_uri.description: Path to the current production batch that triggered the drift alert.

drift_type.description: Classified type of drift from detector fingerprints. Output of Novelty 3 (drift-type classifier).

drift_severity.description: Severity label derived from predicted_harm. none=<1pp, low=1-3pp, moderate=3-7pp, high=7-15pp, critical=>15pp.

predicted_harm.description: Predicted model accuracy or AUC degradation without production labels. Output of Novelty 1 (GBR meta-learner). Expressed as proportion: 0.11 means 11 percentage point drop.

harm_interval.description: 95% conformal prediction bounds on predicted_harm [lower, upper]. Output of Novelty 2.

harm_metric.description: Metric used for predicted_harm and harm_interval. accuracy_drop for balanced datasets, auc_drop for imbalanced (<10% minority class). Selected automatically during onboarding.

affected_features.description: Ranked list of features most affected by drift. Used by C2 to guide SHAP analysis.

ks.description: KS test mean statistic across features

classifier_auc.description: XGBoost C2ST AUC (0.5=no drift, 1.0=perfect separation). C1 contribution.

detectors_fired.description: Count of detectors whose score exceeded their individual alarm threshold. Used by C2 to assess detection consensus.

confidence_stats.description: Model confidence statistics from production batch predictions.

mean_confidence.description: Mean max softmax probability on production batch

notes: predicted_harm is a proportion (0.0-1.0): multiply by 100 to get percentage points
harm_metric is selected during onboarding: accuracy_drop for balanced, auc_drop for imbalanced datasets
detectors_fired is computed as count of detectors with score above their individual threshold
drift_type none means no statistically significant drift detected
model_id, reference_dataset_uri, current_dataset_uri are passed through from platform onboarding config
All float values rounded to 4 decimal places
